hazard_statements: H317 May cause an allergic skin reaction.
May cause eye and skin irritation.

response: If on skin, wash with plenty of water.
If in eyes, rinse cautiously with water for several minutes.
Remove contact lenses when present and easy to remove.
Use the specific treatment stated on the label.
If skin irritation occurs, obtain medical advice or attention.
If eye irritation persists, obtain medical advice or attention.
Remove contaminated clothing and wash it before reuse.

data.other_hazards: Internal SDS inconsistency: H317 normally corresponds to skin sensitization, but the classification list states skin irritation Category 2 and does not list skin sensitization.

verification_notes: Inventory code 16600 matches official Big D product 016600 after restoring the leading zero.
The exact package is a lemon-fragranced 16 oz / 1 lb can, six per case.
The exact manufacturer product page links official SDS 0950.
All required SDS sections were reviewed.

The SDS contains an internal safety-classification conflict: section 2 lists skin irritation Category 2 and eye irritation Category 2B but also gives H317, which ordinarily represents allergic skin reaction/skin sensitization.
Section 11 reports no sensitization information and no skin-irritation information despite those section 2 statements.
The entry should remain in conflicting-sources status until Big D confirms or corrects the current SDS classification.
